items.text: Yankees trade Garrett Cooper and Caleb Smith to the Marlins for Michael King and cash
Rays trade Joel Peralta and Adam Liberatore to the Dodgers for Jose Dominguez and Greg Harris
Mets trade Henry Owens and Matt Lindstrom to the Marlins for Adam Bostick and Jason Vargas
Tigers trade Rick Greene, Mike Myers and Santiago Perez to the Brewers for Bryce Florie
John Smoltz signs with the Braves
Indians trade Bo Diaz to the Phillies
Red Sox trade Jim Pagliaroni and Don Schwall to the Pirates for Dick Stuart and Jack Lamabe

note: 2026 regular-season games are not in Retrosheet yet, so 2026 here is postseason only, taken from Wikipedia's box scores. Retrosheet adds the full season after it ends.
